body:
# All Materials Allowed

This is a mod based on the image meme of Minecraft streamers locking in to craft things that don't actually exist in the game.
Basically, it allows you to craft a large assortment of items using any ingredient. For example, you can have a gold ingot with
a potato handle axe, and it'll chop down trees and work like an axe. Each custom item has a series of deterministic-random properties,
so from world to world the "Gold Ingot with Potato handle Axe" will have X durability, Y speed, and Z damage.

# Warning
This mod can take a lot of RAM and a while to load in. Be prepared for some lag spikes.

## Fixed Recipes

There are a small assortment of fixed recipes, that are not generated.
Most of these don't work yet.

- TNT shovel
- Vertical bread recipe using three wheat in a column
- Rotten flesh helmet
- Rotten flesh chestplate
- Rotten flesh leggings
- Rotten flesh boots
- Tiki torch
- Wither egg
- Bed thing
